name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.208.0 — /spec:prototype can now freeze: on approve, --mark frozen refuses unless the kit gates are green on the prototype tree and a capture exists per declared route and state, then writes structural captures keyed by kit-composite instance (new proto-capture.js, with a --diff comparison) and contract.json, and reserves the behaviour-lane spec and its AC ids; the TESTS step prints one line per behaviour pin, and --mark tests-derived requires every reserved id in the host e2e file and in the host runner's listing, then exports the data/API layer to harden/<stem> via git diff | git apply, writes the brief's Data/API sub-plan and a lint-clean hardened spec, runs dbDestroy, deletes the prototype worktree and branch, and appends one stage: prototype ledger row. 7.207.0 — merge-back.sh create --attach re-attaches a parked spec branch whose worktree directory is gone (prunes the stale entry, keeps the branch's commits, runs the .worktreeinclude copy); plain create still refuses an existing branch. The build driver now runs env-preflight on every invocation, including an implementing resume. /spec:run Step 0 skips isolation for an implementing spec only when no spec branch exists, so a parked worktree build is re-attached instead of resumed on the current branch. 7.206.0 — New /spec:prototype command adds a driver-stepped functional prototype on a proto/<brief> worktree, a dev-only pin overlay with React-fiber stable ids, a local pins endpoint that runs only during a round, and a `prototype` host config block; doctor gains check 23 for that config, and `Lane: behaviour` briefs are redirected away from /spec:plan; red-check now expands a directory tests row into its files instead of crashing on EISDIR.
